scrapeunblocker.description: Fetch any web page through the ScrapeUnblocker anti-bot API (Cloudflare, DataDome, PerimeterX, Akamai, Shape). Tools: fetch_html (fully rendered HTML), fetch_markdown (a page as clean Markdown), fetch_parsed (AI-parsed structured JSON), google_search (organic SERP results), search_and_read (a Google search plus its top pages as Markdown), list_elements (selectors for a page's links, inputs and buttons), list_plugins / run_plugin (100+ ready-made site scrapers returning JSON), and the most-used of those as tools of their own (Amazon, Walmart, eBay, Google Shopping / Local / Maps / Images, YouTube, Zillow, Indeed, Trustpilot, Booking.com).
